newsitem.title: USA: Nordstrom sees space rising 8-10 pct/yr.
newsitem.headline: Nordstrom sees space rising 8-10 pct/yr.

text.p: Nordstrom Inc Co-Chairman John Whitacre reiterated the up-market retailer plans to grow its presence nationally with an average eight to ten percent annual increase in floorspace through the year 2000.
"Through the rest of the decade we will grow eight to 10 percent," he said of the store expansion plans.
In a presentation to investors at a Montgomery Securities conference here, Whitacre said retail space is growing by 935,000 square feet, or 9.8 percent, in 1996.
He said that after a planned opening in Atlanta in 1998 and in preparation for stores in Florida in the next decade, Nordstrom would likely establish a distribution facility for the Southeast region.
